description: Suggestions to improve decision-making and to discover missing information. Each suggestion is proposed for review; a reviewer can approve, reject or choose a path. Status is 'proposed' until a reviewer acts.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a mandatory Decision Gate checklist that must be completed before any strategy or data change is implemented.
suggestions.rationale: Forces every change to be justified against the open questions and the have/don't-have inventory.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Fewer premature decisions; every change traces to an answered question.

suggestions.suggestion: Build an automated official-feed ingestion layer (schedule, injury, roster, stats) with logged cadence and latency per feed.
suggestions.rationale: Removes manual input (R16) and makes signals reproducible and timely.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Reliable, automated signal inputs with measurable freshness.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a model-origination module that emits model-implied probabilities per market and labels every output as model-originated, never as sourced market data.
suggestions.rationale: Directly implements 'originate my own NFL lines' while keeping honesty about what is modelled versus sourced.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Self-generated lines that are clearly labelled and auditable.

suggestions.suggestion: Estimate correlation from official play-level data and publish a correlation matrix for each bet-type combination.
suggestions.rationale: Provides the correlation values required by R10 and prevents overstating parlay value.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Empirical, sourced correlation values replacing blanks.

suggestions.suggestion: Build a configurable validation-gate engine that blocks leaderboard entry when any gate fails.
suggestions.rationale: Enforces R9 and keeps unvalidated strategies out of the ranking.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Only gate-passing strategies are eligible and ranked.

suggestions.suggestion: Rank strategies on a luck-adjusted, risk-adjusted metric (edge vs market / closing-line value, selectivity-weighted) rather than raw hit rate.
suggestions.rationale: Implements 'remove luck' (R11) and rewards selective skill over high-volume variance.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: A leaderboard that rewards demonstrable skill, not luck.

suggestions.suggestion: Add an injury/starter-backup signal layer that maps each team's depth chart to an expected signal impact and flags any game where a 2nd/3rd/4th-string player is starting on offense or defense.
suggestions.rationale: Implements R13 and R14; turns roster state into an explicit, sourced signal.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Quantified starter/backup signals for offenses and defenses.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a suggestions review workflow with approve/reject and a recorded 'chosen path' before implementation.
suggestions.rationale: Implements the dedicated Suggestions section (R2) and the review-then-implement flow.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: A reviewable suggestion register with an explicit decision recorded per item.

suggestions.suggestion: Publish a source registry page with per-source verification status (live / snapshot / unavailable).
suggestions.rationale: Supports R24 and lets reviewers see exactly what each value traces to.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Full traceability of every sourced value.

suggestions.suggestion: Publish a Flagged for Review page listing every unverified or blank value with its source link.
suggestions.rationale: Implements R25 and R26: blanks are visible, never inferred, always flagged.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: No hidden gaps; reviewers can see exactly what is unverified.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a responsible-gaming disclosure and jurisdiction note to every page.
suggestions.rationale: Implements R29 and makes the risk and research-only nature explicit.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: Clear compliance and risk disclosure on the site.

suggestions.suggestion: Publish a leaderboard with reward tiers, eligibility gated by validation, and a documented tie-break.
suggestions.expectedOutcome: A competition that rewards validated, skill-based strategies.

suggestions.suggestion: Maintain an executive summary that lists verified anchors, what we have, what we lack, and the decisions needed.
suggestions.rationale: Implements R15 and gives a one-page decision view.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a line-by-line verification script that fails the build if any table row lacks a source link or contains an unflagged blank.
suggestions.rationale: Enforces R24, R25 and R26 automatically (R16).
suggestions.expectedOutcome: A build that cannot ship unsourced or silently-inferred values.

suggestions.suggestion: Add a 'what we have / what we don't have' inventory to every decision-bearing page.
suggestions.rationale: Makes the information gaps visible at the point of decision (R3).
suggestions.expectedOutcome: No decision made on an invisible gap.
